Marking its 12th anniversary, Roborock (石頭科技), a high-tech cleaning company, is launching anniversary promotions from now until September 6, offering substantial discounts on its entire range of robot vacuums and other products.

The anniversary offers cover its products and bundles, with discounts ranging from 25% to over 50%, with savings of up to $1,600...

Saros 20

The Saros 20 (pictured above) is Roborock's flagship smart robot vacuum, offering unprecedented real-world intelligence, designed for larger and more complex North American homes. Key features include the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0, a carpet intelligence system, and Smart Plan 3.0.

StarSight is the most advanced autonomous navigation system on the market, combining dual-emission solid-state LiDAR and 3D Time-of-Flight technology to precisely construct highly detailed 3D maps of the home. It can reliably identify and avoid over 300 different types of obstacles, ranging from loose cables to pets.

The AdaptiLift Chassis is an advanced system that identifies room thresholds and steps, then uses motorized support legs to automatically lift the Saros 20 over them, ensuring uninterrupted whole-home cleaning. Similarly, the carpet intelligence system automatically adjusts the vacuum's body height to maintain optimal suction for deep cleaning carpets with pile up to 3 cm.

Smart Plan 2.0 is an AI-driven intelligent cleaning system that automatically optimizes cleaning routes by analyzing your home's unique layout, flooring materials, and the usage habits of all household members.

Qrevo 2 Pro

The all-new Qrevo 2 Pro makes its U.S. debut as the ultimate robot vacuum for pet households. Designed for stubborn stains and pet hair, it features a dual zero-tangle system and 20,000 Pa suction to remove 100% of hair with zero tangles. This robot vacuum easily handles pet dander and hair, cat litter, cereal crumbs, and muddy paw prints.

The toughest situation is having both pets and long-pile carpets. The Qrevo Pro 2 handles this effortlessly with its auto mop-removal feature, leaving the mop at the charging dock to ensure carpets stay completely dry.

F25 Steam

The F25 Steam is the ultimate handheld wet and dry vacuum, combining 25,000 Pa suction with VaporFlow steam cleaning at 356°F.

Key features include: 80 minutes of continuous runtime to clean the entire home; a 180-degree lay-flat design for reaching under furniture; blue light to reveal hidden dust; and a full-auto steam self-cleaning and hot air-drying function upon completion.

F25 XT

If you need powerful wet and dry cleaning without steam, the F25 XT offers 20,000 Pa suction and features SlideTech 2.0 wheels for a smoother, easier cleaning experience.

The F25 XT delivers true edge-to-edge wet and dry cleaning for a perfect clean in one pass. The JawScrapers roller features a shark-tooth blade anti-tangle brush that effectively captures hair, while the continuous pressurized squeegee design ensures no water streaks are left on the floor. It also features the F25 Steam's 180-degree lay-flat design, with up to 60 minutes of battery life in eco mode—enough to clean up to 4,400 square feet on a single charge.

More Deals

The Qrevo S Pro and the company's two most popular bundles are also heavily discounted:

  • Qrevo S Pro: Originally $699.99, now just $429.99, saving $270 (38%)
  • Saros 20 + F25GT Bundle: Originally $1,899.99, now just $1,269.98, saving $630 (33%)
  • Qrevo S Pro + F25GT Bundle: Originally $999.98, now just $549.98, saving $450 (45%)

All promotional prices end September 6, so don't miss out.
